title: Replication Data for: The Effect of Retrieval Practice on the Retention and Application of Verb Spelling Rules in elementary education.
descriptions: A study about the effects of retrieval practice on the retention and application of verb spelling rules in primary education. Participants are 105 fourth grade pupils from three different regular elementary schools in the Netherlands.
